title: g-tee-oh validation report
description: The envelope every JSON report under validation/reports/ follows (R0.11; validation/reports/README.md explains each field). A gate report is judged, so it carries pass and thresholds. The bench baseline (report = bench) is what later thresholds are measured against (O-40), so it carries neither. Markdown gate summaries do not use this schema.

report.description: The report id: the file name without the machine suffix and the extension (bench-zenbook.json carries bench, perf-zenbook.json carries perf, recompute.json carries recompute).

r_ids.description: The requirement identifiers the report proves, R<phase>.<n>.

commit.description: git rev-parse HEAD when the report was written.

date.description: When the report was written, ISO 8601 in Coordinated Universal Time with the Z suffix (the pattern stands in for the date-time format so ajv needs no formats plugin).

toolchain.description: The compiler or runtime that built what was measured, for example the output of rustc --version.

pass.description: True when every measurement meets its threshold. Required for a gate report, forbidden on the bench baseline.

measurements.description: One entry per measured quantity, at least one.

seed.description: The seed of a seeded sample, for example the 200 recompute attempts (O-60).

notes.description: What the tool wants a reader to know: an extrapolated figure, an unavailable input.

machine.description: The machine that produced the measurements; the name is also the file name suffix. A tool may add fields, for example the Docker virtual machine memory on the Mac (O-20).

threshold.description: A limit a measurement is judged against: a bare number in the measurement's unit, or an object naming the bound.

thresholds.description: The limits the measurements were judged against, keyed by measurement id or by a named limit (O-40 names three for perf-zenbook.json).

measurement.description: One measured quantity. value is the general form; mean_ns with median_ns is the criterion form the bench baseline uses. A tool may add fields.

stub.description: True when the routine is a placeholder and the number is not a product measurement.
